# Hashtag Web3 — Jobs & Hiring Scoped Context

> Scoped documentation for Web3 job search, dedicated individual job listings, crypto compensation benchmarks, hiring companies, and career tools.

## Dedicated Job Listing Pages

Every verified Web3 job has an authoritative, structured, 500+ word editorial page containing full role specifications, technical requirements, compensation benchmarks, interview roadmaps, and direct application links:
- URL Pattern: `https://hashtagweb3.com/jobs/{company}-{role-title}-{jobId}`
- Example: `https://hashtagweb3.com/jobs/coinbase-staff-software-engineer-backend-8154983`
- Example: `https://hashtagweb3.com/jobs/stripe-finance-engineer-8153331`
- Example: `https://hashtagweb3.com/jobs/bitgo-onboarding-manager-91029373`

## Job Feeds & Categories

- [All Web3 Jobs](https://hashtagweb3.com/jobs): 3,000+ verified active job postings.
- [Hiring Companies Directory](https://hashtagweb3.com/companies): 150+ Web3-native companies actively recruiting.
- [Salary Calculator](https://hashtagweb3.com/salary-calculator): Market-verified compensation benchmarks and token allocation guides.
- [Crypto Resume Builder](https://hashtagweb3.com/resume-builder): On-chain project & GitHub portfolio resume builder.
- [Web3 Interview Questions](https://hashtagweb3.com/interview-questions): 200+ interview questions for Solidity, Rust, DeFi, and ZK roles.
- [Archetype Quiz](https://hashtagweb3.com/web3-career-quiz): Career assessment for Web3 roles.
- [Telegram Job Feed](https://t.me/web3hiring): Live alert feed with 60,000+ subscribers.

## REST API Access

- Endpoint: `GET https://hashtagweb3.com/api/v1/jobs`
- Query parameters:
  - `search` (e.g. `Solidity`, `Auditor`, `Frontend`)
  - `tag` (e.g. `Ethereum`, `Solana`, `DeFi`)
  - `company` (e.g. `Uniswap Labs`, `Coinbase`)
  - `limit` (default 50, max 200)
  - `offset` (default 0)
  - `cursor` (base64 cursor token)
